name: MEHUL AGARWAL
summary: Product Manager with 4+ years building digital lending products in fintech, currently owning the Home Loan digital acquisition stack at Bajaj Finance -- from credit eligibility rules to lead allocation and lending-partner integrations. Operates across both strategic and tactical layers of the role: shaping roadmap and partnership strategy with Business and Credit Policy teams, while running sprint planning, backlog grooming, and specs with Engineering and Design. Previously owned the Personal Loan digital platform end-to-end, from requirements through post-launch iteration. Grounded in data -- uses Google Analytics, CleverTap, and Looker Studio to validate decisions and prioritize the roadmap.

roles.title: Product Manager - Home Loan: Digital Platforms and Consumer AI
bullets: Own product strategy for Home Loan digital acquisition, translating business and credit-policy requirements into scalable lead-generation and qualification systems.
Define requirements and drive execution of digital campaign infrastructure across search, social, and paid channels to generate high-quality home loan demand.
Lead product requirements for strategic NBFC and financial-institution partnerships, designing lead-exchange and commission workflows with legal, business, and tech teams.

Design and ship the MCP (Minimum Credit Parameters) Master and Lead Allocation Master -- a rules engine that pre-qualifies leads and routes them to the right lending partner based on credit profile, eligibility, and business rules.
Map and optimize the end-to-end digital home loan funnel -- from awareness and lead generation through login, sanction, and disbursal -- identifying drop-off points and prioritizing fixes.
